messages:
Maya L: quick async standup — preflight for tomorrow's feature-flag ramp. TL;DR: prepping surge mitigations and warmup slices.
Vikas R: what I did: added rate-limiter hook to gateway, updated fallback weights for model-variant B.
Vikas R: blocker: seeing ~1.5% 500s on slice-7 under synthetic load, unclear if it's infra or model OOM.
Zara P: noted. I queued some extra GPU capacity on dedicated pool and warmed caches for slice-7. Can you paste the failing logs? @vikas
Vikas R: logs snippet:
```
2026-02-11T09:12:03Z model-server[pid]: ERR kv-cache: miss stream_id=abcd1234 size=0
2026-02-11T09:12:03Z proxy[pid]: 500 POST /v1/generate model=variant-b seq=2048
```
James H: quick check — did you hit the new kernel selector? That `seq=2048` path sometimes triggers legacy code path.
Vikas R: yeah, might be falling back. I rolled a patch to force new kernels for that seq range on dev only. Monitoring right now.
Eli: FYI I opened a small PR to make the fallback emit a metric `runtime.fallback_kernel` so we can alert. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/serving/pulls/3421 :eyes:
Maya L: ops plan for ramp tomorrow: 1) enable feature-flag `ff.launch.surge-mitigate` at 1% 2) run warmup traffic slice for 10m 3) monitor `5xx_rate` and `latency.p95` for 15m window 4) if 5xx > 0.5% rollback flag immediately.
Zara P: sounds good. I'll own the warmup traffic. schedule: 08:30 UTC warmup; 09:00 UTC start 1% roll.
deploy-bot: [INFO] canary deployment started for `feature/surge-mitigate` at 2026-02-11T08:59:12Z — slices: slice-7, slice-9.
Vikas R: update: after forcing kernel path in dev, errors dropped to 0.2% under same load. I'll promote patch to canary within the hour.
Maya L: blocker for me: need final approval on the incident runbook change (added the `fallthrough` step for model-variant fallback). @james can you glance?
James H: on it, will review now. if small, ack and we can proceed.
ops-bot: [SCHEDULE] warmup traffic scheduled for 2026-02-11T08:30:00Z; expected duration 10m.
Maya L: final note — please ping in this thread when you flip the flag so SRE can trigger the extra autoscale policy if needed. :thumbsup:
Zara P: will do. planning a short post-warmup checklist message in here with metrics snapshot.
Eli: quick CR ping for the metric PR — leaving one tiny comment, otherwise LGTM.
Vikas R: pushed canary patch to `canary/variant-b-kernel-fix`, starting canary rollout now. will report back in ~10m.
Maya L: thanks team — adding blocker flag if errors creep up. otherwise we'll proceed with staged ramp at 09:00 UTC. :rocket:
